Handy linear commands from the command line.

Usage: linear [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  auth               Manage Linear authentication
  issue              Manage Linear issues [alias: i]
  team               Manage Linear teams [alias: t]
  user               Manage Linear users [alias: u]
  project            Manage Linear projects [alias: p]
  project-update     Manage project status updates [alias: pu]
  cycle              Manage Linear team cycles [alias: cy]
  milestone          Manage Linear project milestones [alias: m]
  initiative         Manage Linear initiatives [alias: init]
  initiative-update  Manage initiative status updates (timeline posts) [alias: iu]
  label              Manage Linear issue labels [alias: l]
  template           Browse Linear issue, project, and document templates. Apply one with `issue create --template` or `project create --template`.
  document           Manage Linear documents [aliases: docs, doc]
  completions        Generate shell completions.
  config             Interactively generate .linear.toml configuration [alias: configure]
  schema             Print the GraphQL schema to stdout
  api                Make a raw GraphQL API request
  markdown           Linear-flavored Markdown: mentions and collapsible sections
  help               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --workspace <slug>  Target workspace (uses credentials)
  -h, --help              Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version           Print version
